notices.title: Midterm Exam Timetable Released
notices.name: Mrs. Adaeze Okoro
notices.newsText: The midterm examination timetable for all departments is now available on the student portal. Please confirm your exam venue before your first paper.

notices.title: Inter-House Sports Day — Save the Date
notices.name: Mr. Tunde Bello
notices.newsText: This year's Inter-House Sports Day will hold on the main field. Events include track races, tug of war, and a staff-vs-students football match.

notices.title: Library Extended Hours During Exam Week
notices.name: Admin Office
notices.newsText: The main library will stay open until midnight starting next Monday to support exam preparation. Bring your student ID for after-hours access.

notices.title: Cafeteria Closed for Maintenance This Friday
notices.name: Facilities Team
notices.newsText: The main cafeteria will be closed this Friday for equipment servicing. The smaller snack bar near the hostel block will remain open for meals.

notices.title: Lost Water Bottle — Blue with Stickers
notices.name: Chinedu Eze
notices.newsText: Lost a blue water bottle covered in stickers somewhere near the sports field. If found, please drop it at the front office.

notices.title: Unofficial Bake Sale Announcement
notices.name: Grace Adamu
notices.newsText: Selling homemade cookies by the parking lot on Friday, not affiliated with the school. Please buy some!
